lines.text: The AZX continues to race.
We all stare out the windows. We can't help but feel nervous.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: There's an unconfirmed entity up ahead.
Brid transmits the AZX's screen.
In the distance, someone is standing in the path of the train.
They're too far away to see clearly, but their distinct silhouette is impossible to forget.
Altruia!

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: ... A Heretic.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Huh? R-really? Then shouldn't we stop?

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: N-not even the AZX would be able to withstand a head-on collision with a Heretic...

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I don't see why not. It's worth a shot.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: What?! Wh-what are you talking about?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Commander, what should we do?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Wait...! There's a heat source rapidly approaching from the air!

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Brace for impact!
*Booooom!*

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Aaahhh!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander!
It feels like I'm floating.
Suddenly, fireworks burst in my vision as my whole body suffers a shock.
I feel like I'm going to pass out... But then...
I see Egovista looking at me, smiling with her greatsword stuck in the floor, and I desperately cling to consciousness.
... She sliced through the train as she came down.
*Krrrrkkkk!*
With the deafening crunch of crushing metal, the AZX is overturned. I grab onto something I can't even identify and hang on for dear life.
The inside of the AZX is a mess.
I try to shake off my dizziness and do my best to assess the situation.
Brid, Diesel, and Soline are unconscious.
Rapi flew into a wall and is trying to regain her balance.
Anis and Neon are on the floor,
and Egovista and Altruia are approaching them.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Comest thou with me.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I'll take the other one.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: What? Me?
Egovista takes Anis, Altruia takes Neon, and they quickly break away.
No...! Rapi!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Ro... ger...!
Rapi regains her composure, activates Seven Dwarves Zero, and just as she prepares to fly,
a thick dust cloud rushes over from where the Goddess of Victory statue is.
It's fast. The dust closes in on us in moments.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Nayuta.
... A horde of Nayutas are running toward us.
Their eyes are red.
... Great.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Clones of you created using the Queen's internal production facilities.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: There must be around two thousand of them, huh? Very impressive.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Two thousand corrupted human imposters...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Let us press on toward the Ark.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: And as for me...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I will help the Queen complete her great work.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Hehe, the Queen is clear in her purpose.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: She thinks only of killing humans.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander!
... Wait just a sec.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I have no idea how there are so many Nayutas, but they're all corrupt!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We can't retreat! Infinity Rail is here!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... We have to open fire!
... What's the best course of action? Anis and Neon were taken away by those Heretics.
Should we go after them? If we do, it wouldn't leave anyone here to protect everyone in Infinity Rail, who're still unconscious.
What is with all those Nayutas? How are there so many of them?
And they're corrupted. I doubt they'll just run past Infinity Rail.
Two taken by Heretics. Three unconscious.
A numberless amount of corrupted Nikkes are coming.
... How do we handle this? What should we do?
The Nayutas grow closer.
I look at one at the front of the pack.
... She's making eye contact with me.
I look at the others.
... They're all making eye contact with me. They're all watching me.
Their eyes are red. And yet...
I see something in them that I've seen more times than I can count:
the look of someone who's prepared to die.
... Fire.
Open fire, Rapi!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Roger that...!
*Rat-tat-tat-tat-tat!*
Rapi faces forward and fires blindly.
One after another, the Nayutas begin to fall. Just like before, they disappear in blue flame.
*Rat-tat-tat-tat-tat!*
Rapi keeps firing, and they keep falling.
... Something's off.
There's no reaction.
They just keep running, get hit, and drop.
It's almost as if...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm going to use the drill! There's too many...!
Just then, a dust cloud from far away begins charging toward the side of the Nayutas.
It's moving at an incredible speed. It closes in on the Nayutas in moments.
And without hesitation, it charges straight into the horde.
*Bang! Clang! Boom!*
With loud bangs and booms, Nayutas are sent flying into the air.
The dust cloud doesn't stop. It pierces the swarm of Nayutas without even slowing.
Before long, it changes direction and comes charging at us.
*Bang! Clang! Boom!*
Nayutas go flying like paper dolls.
The cloud of dust grows steadily closer.
Before long, the source of the cloud stops in front of us.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Good to see you. You haven't changed a bit, Visor.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Trying to face all those things on your own? I'm disappointed! And you call yourself an advisor!
... First, it's "advisor," not "visor." And second, I never said agreed to being one.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Crown... Chime...
Crown and Chime look down on us from Trombe's back.
As they stand, haloed in sunlight, they look like knights in shining armor come to rescue us.
*Whooosh! Boom!*
T.A.L.O.S. lands with a heavy thud.
It goes over to inspect the unconscious Brid, Diesel, and Soline.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: T.A.L.O.S. How's everyone looking?

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: They're all suffering from severe bruising and frame damage. Their lives aren't in peril, but they cannot operate normally.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Can you fix them?

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: I can give them first aid, but they'll need to visit the Repair Center to receive proper treatment.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Okay, then let's at least perform first aid for now.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Roger that.
Kilo! T.A.L.O.S.!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You're here too...!

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: H-hey, Commander, Rapi. It's been a long time, huh?

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Nice to see you.
I had heard you were with White Knight, but it's still a surprise.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Oh, yeah. It kinda just... turned out that way.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Kilo. You needn't be embarrassed.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: B-be quiet...
... T.A.L.O.S. still has a great chest.

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Calculating.

lines.speaker: kilo_op_l
lines.text: Y-yeah it does! You bet!

lines.speaker: talos
lines.text: Thank you for the compliment. I'm proud of it.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander, this is neither the time nor place.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Unsurprisingly, you have a good eye. You are truly worthy of your title, Advisor.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Hmph. You're just as perceptive as ever.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Let us save the pleasantries for later. For now, we must overdo the immediate crisis.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: "Overcome," Your Highness. Not "overdo."

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: ... Yes, I suppose some might also use that word. Hehe.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: As you can see, we're facing a large number of corrupted Nikkes.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Can you handle them?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: And what do you think we were just doing?

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: You needn't worry. Her Highness does not hesitate.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: The enemies' movements are quite slow.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: I'll dispatch of them as quickly as possible.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: They're... slow...?
Yeah, it looked that way to me too. Also, looking at their eyes... I can tell.
Nayuta is planning something.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: I think I can guess what that crazy monk is up to.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: ... She's still using her life as a weapon.
Rapi, Crown, Chime. Take out the Nayutas as quickly as possible.
Kilo and T.A.L.O.S., please protect Infinity Rail.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Commander, we should leave this to White Knight so we can go after Anis and Neon.
No. We can't leave White Knight to face that many enemies.
Their movements may be slow, but we can't count on that always being the case.
Anis and Neon are strong. Believe in them. Remember, they're members of the Commando Unit, Counters.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: All right. I'll trust them.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Hmph, do you not trust your own squad members?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I just said I did.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Save your excuses. Let's just take those things down!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You're the one who keeps yapping.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Hey...! You listen here! I am the king's secretary and the Crown Kingdom's very own—

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Encounter!
A buzzing sound tears through the air...
... as Rapi activates her drill and charges toward the Nayutas.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Ugh... Aggghhh...!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Let's go. Hold on tight, Chime.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Argh...! All right, Your Highness!

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Forward, Trombe!
Chime pulls explosives out of her pack, and Trombe gallops forward.
There are flashes of red and white in the crowd of Nayutas.
The monks die in groups, unable to avoid the explosions.
With a flash of blue flame, they disappear without a trace.
I keep watching.
Red particles emerge from the vanished Nayutas,
and then go flying toward the Goddess of Victory statue.
Altruia flies as if she's pushing Neon forward with her four arms.
Each of Neon's arms is trapped by two of Altruia's.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Are you not even a little ashamed at how cowardly this is?

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I don't think of it that way.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: But it's strange. I'm making shields with all of my hands.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: How are both of your arms still whole?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Ah, so that's why I was feeling those little pinches.
Neon starts thinking of how to avoid getting further separated from the others.
With her arms restrained, she can't use her weapon.
Her only choice, then, is to use her body.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Hup...!
Neon throws her head back,
bashing it into Altruia's head.
*Thwack!*
Altruia is caught off guard and lets go of Neon's arms. The two of them fall together.
Neon immediately pulls out her weapon as she quickly gets to her feet, and then points it at Altruia, who's still lying on the ground.
*Bam! Bam! Bam! Bam!*
Explosions and golden sparks continuously burst out.
After firing at Altruia for a while, Neon gets the sense that something's off.
Altruia lies in the hole just created in the ground, unharmed.
She rises, still in her same pose, and brings her face close to Neon's.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Don't resist.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: It'll only bring you more pain.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I really try not to comment on others' looks, but your face makes me really uncomfortable.
*Kwoosh!*
Altruia stretches out her hand, and a green shield bursts out from it.
It collides with Neon, pushing her back.
*Kwoosh! Kwoosh! Kwoosh! Kwoosh!*
Altruia makes shield after shield, steadily pushing Neon back.
Neon raises her gun and pulls the trigger.
Altruia creates a shield right in front of her gun.
*Boom!*
There's an explosion in front of the gun, and Neon gets knocked back.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Ack!

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Resistance is futile.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Your abilities cannot pierce the barrier given to me by Mother.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: And here I thought you were just good at defense. I didn't realize you could use those like that.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: It would've been better for you to fight alongside Egovista, though. Why did you decide to go in different directions?

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: While fighting alongside Egovista is an extremely enjoyable experience,

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: when you are with your comrades, you exceed our power.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Ah, so you're scared of us because we have such good chemistry?

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Precisely.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: You know, we're still plenty strong on our own.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I know. That is why we played to our strengths when we chose which of you we would fight.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Hmm... That is a very good strategic decision.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I'm sure you'd rather have taken out the Goddess Squad one by one, but you figured you would lose against them, so you came after us instead.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I implore you.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Do not resist. Stay still.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: If you do, this will end without pain.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wow. It's annoying to hear you say that, as though you're obviously going to win.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I am a merciful saint.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: The outcome of this battle is already clear. My duty is to send you off as peacefully as possible.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I pray you'll accept my grace.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: If you really wanted to show me grace, then shouldn't you be the one to sit there and do nothing?

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: That would not change any of your fates.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Everyone's fate has already been decided, ever since the moment of Mother's advent.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Sending you on the path to destruction as peacefully as possible...

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: ... is the smallest mercy I can offer.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Huh... So you're saying I should just accept my fate because it's already been decided?

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Correct. It brings me joy to hear that you understand.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I could never agree to that.
With a clack, Neon points her gun at Altruia.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I suspected it would come to this.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: Ohhh... How it saddens me, this needless tragedy.
Neon pulls the trigger over and over.
Altruia's shield blocks every attack.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: ... Great force is behind each shot. Those are no ordinary bullets, I take it.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Beats me. I don't exactly know the details.
Shields appear all around Neon.
They start to close in on her.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Oh, are you trying to trap me?

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: I am going to crush you.

lines.speaker: altruia
lines.text: It will be very painful. I suggest you end your own life.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Yikes. I'm just gonna break through, so how about you keep your weird suggestions to yourself!
Neon keeps pressing the trigger to blast through the shield in front of her.
The explosions continue, but the shields continue to close in on her.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: ... Uh oh. I might actually be in danger, huh?
*Crash!*
Anis rolls roughly along the ground.
She springs to her feet and faces forward.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... Is the goal to take us down one at a time? You guys must be pretty scared.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Thine observation is shrewd.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: So this here is just you and me, one-on-one?

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Ay.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... Any chance I can swap opponents?

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: None. Never would we agree to such.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: What, and you're just fine being complete cowards? C'mon, I should obviously be fighting the one with the four arms.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: 'Twould make us a poor match.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: The one with spectacles is much sturdier than her looks. My blade affects her but little.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: And also, thou canst set at nought Altruia's shields, swallowing them up as it were.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: We need not put ourselves in disadvantage.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Wait, but aren't you supposed to be like a... swordswoman or something?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You don't really sound like one, only picking fights you can win. That just makes you a bully.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I'm right, aren't I? A swordswoman should be able to fight her way out of any crisis using her blade alone! Right?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: And is that what you're doing now? Huh? Is it?

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Verily, I was of thy mind once.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Methought the essence of battle to be a fierce clash of strength, and of the blade, a tool to convey one's will.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: However, Scarlet did speak me thus.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: A sword is but an instrument of death.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Thereupon did I resolve;

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: my sword too shall be but an instrument of death.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Ugh, Scarlet...! Why'd you have to go and say that?!

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: Thus it is. I will slay thee with my blade.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Wait! I actually have my own thoughts about the subject! I would say the sword is more like, um...!
Egovista shoots up into the air.
She traces a dizzying arc in the air before launching toward Anis.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Ugh...!
With a loud noise, Egovista's sword slices the ground.
Anis barely manages to get out of the way and then swings her fist at Egovista.
However, Egovista rises into the air again, arcs, and descends.
Anis aims upward and fires her weapon, but not a single shot lands.
The sword strikes down once again.
Anis barely dodges in time. The tips of her hair are cut off and flutter away.
The sword splits the ground again.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Erk...!
Egovista flicks her sword up, sending stones and dirt spraying into Anis's face.
Anis instinctively squeezes her eyes shut.
Egovista uses that opening to launch toward her.
Anis gets ready to take a blow and give one in return. Light gathers around her fist.
Just out of Anis's range, Egovista shoots into the air again as Anis throws an uppercut at nothing but air.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... Wow, you really are fighting like a coward.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: There is neither cowardice nor bravery in killing.
When her uppercut misses, Anis loses her balance and stumbles, and Egovista swings her blade down.
Anis thinks to herself, "Should I block it? No, it'd cut straight through my arm."
She can't avoid it. It's too fast.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Argh...!
Anis swings her fists wildly.
Her form is terrible, and she's off-balance, but she manages to strike the blade.
*Flash!*
There's a flash shaped like a star.
The shock changes the arc of Egovista's sword, driving it into the ground.
Anis frantically runs, distancing herself from Egovista.
Her hand is tingling.
Egovista laughs heartily and adjusts her grip on her sword.

lines.speaker: egovista
lines.text: I trust thou knowest the same trick shall not save thee twice.
In her mind, Anis can't help but agree. That really won't work again. She got lucky, incredibly lucky.
Had her timing been off by a second, her head would've been split wide open.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... This is bad.
